title: Theory of Situations
summary: Guy Brousseau began developing the theory of situations in the 1960s, with the ambition of building an experimental epistemology of mathematics. Over the decades, the theory has been structured, consolidated and extended, drawing on the contributions of numerous researchers. It is now recognized as one of the ''genuine ground theories'' in mathematics education. In this chapter, we will describe the foundations and reasons for the existence of this theory, its systemic approach to teaching and learning issues, its current architecture, which articulates a theory of mathematical situations…
